Blocking client for remote signing requests over shared-memory mcaches.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_keyguard_client` interface for a blocking client that sends signing requests to a remote keyguard tile through shared-memory `mcache` and data regions. The header documents the memory layout and access rules for the request and response channels, including alignment, footprint, and the requirement that each channel map to a single role with exclusive access. It declares lifecycle functions such as [`fd_keyguard_client_new`](<#fd_keyguard_client_new>), [`fd_keyguard_client_join`](<#fd_keyguard_client_join>), [`fd_keyguard_client_leave`](<#fd_keyguard_client_leave>), and [`fd_keyguard_client_delete`](<#fd_keyguard_client_delete>), which manage the client object in shared memory. It also declares [`fd_keyguard_client_sign`](<#fd_keyguard_client_sign>), which sends sign data, waits for a 64-byte signature response, and treats signing failures as fatal conditions.
